project.name: pacgate-ai
project.description: Privacy-first local legal AI platform - Rust metadata spine for multi-tenant attorney offices. Owns tenant/matter/document/citation typed graph, DOCX engine, RAG, LLM router, auth, and HTTP gateway. Integrates deer-flow (research runtime) and qm (collaboration runtime) via thin adapters.

nodes.name: pacgate-core/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Shared types for the entire workspace. Defines TenantId, MatterId, DocumentId, UserId, PersonaId, WorkflowId, TemplateId, MessageId, ConversationId, KbItemId as typed UUID newtypes. LlmTier (Main/Mid/Low), LlmProvider (Ollama/Anthropic/OpenAI/Qwen/DeepSeek/MiniMax/Custom), ModelConfig with per-tenant model_overrides. Jurisdiction (26 jurisdictions including China mainland, HK, US, UK, EU). PracticeArea (international + China-specific). Document model with tenant_id/matter_id/version/storage_path/owner_id. Matter model with tenant_id/persona_id/created_by. CitationRef with document_id/page/verbatim. AgentMessage/ToolCall/ToolResult for agent loop. PacgateError error enum.

nodes.name: pacgate-docx/lib.rs
nodes.summary: DOCX generation engine entry point. Public API for building OOXML documents programmatically.

nodes.name: pacgate-docx/builder.rs
nodes.summary: Document builder - assembles OOXML structure from parts (paragraphs, tables, headings, styles).

nodes.name: pacgate-docx/styles.rs
nodes.summary: Style definitions for DOCX generation - heading levels, fonts, spacing, legal document formatting.

nodes.name: pacgate-docx/ooxml.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level OOXML XML generation - produces the Word document XML schema compliant output.

nodes.name: pacgate-docx/diff.rs
nodes.summary: Document diff engine - compares two document versions and produces tracked changes (similar to Word's track changes feature).

nodes.name: pacgate-api/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Axum HTTP router with all API routes: /api/chat, /api/chat/stream (SSE), /api/documents (CRUD + versions + download + edit + accept_changes), /api/matters (CRUD + list documents), /api/workflows (list + get), /api/tabular (batch review). CORS + tracing middleware.

nodes.name: pacgate-api/state.rs
nodes.summary: AppState injected into Axum handlers via State extractor. Holds Arc<AgentLoop>, Arc<LlmRouter>, Arc<ToolDispatcher>, Arc<AppConfig>. AppConfig has data_dir (default ./data) and max_upload_mb (50).

nodes.name: pacgate-api/chat.rs
nodes.summary: Chat handler - accepts ChatRequest {matter_id, message, persona_id, history}. Runs AgentLoop.run(). Returns ChatResponse {message_id, content, citations, tools_used}. Also has SSE streaming handler for real-time response. Citations are extracted from assistant messages.

nodes.name: pacgate-api/documents.rs
nodes.summary: Document CRUD handlers - upload (multipart), get, delete, list_versions, download, edit, accept_changes, start_tabular_review. Currently returns 'storage layer not yet wired' errors - needs pacgate-docx storage backend implementation.

nodes.name: pacgate-api/matters.rs
nodes.summary: Matter CRUD handlers - create_matter (name, description, persona_id), list_matters, get_matter, delete_matter, list_matter_documents. Currently returns 'matter store not yet wired' errors - needs pacgate-tenant storage backend.

nodes.name: pacgate-api/workflows.rs
nodes.summary: Workflow list and get handlers - exposes the 160+ workflow template library.

nodes.name: pacgate-api/error.rs
nodes.summary: ApiError type - bad_request, internal, not_found. Implements IntoResponse for Axum.

nodes.name: pacgate-agent/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Local fallback agent runtime. AgentLoop + ToolDispatcher with 10-tool architecture (inspired by Mike's chatTools.ts). Tools: ReadDocument, FindInDocument, FetchDocuments, ListDocuments, GenerateDocx, EditDocument, ReplicateDocument, ReadWorkflow, ReadTableCells, KbSearch. DocumentStore trait (async) for storage abstraction. Citation extraction pass on assistant messages. Types: ReadDocumentArgs, FindInDocumentArgs, FetchDocumentsArgs, ListDocumentsArgs, GenerateDocxArgs, EditDocumentArgs, ReplicateDocumentArgs, ReadWorkflowArgs, ReadTableCellsArgs, KbSearchArgs, FindResult.

nodes.name: system_prompt_base.txt
nodes.summary: Base system prompt for the Pacgate AI agent: 'You are Pacgate AI — a sovereign, privacy-first legal AI assistant built on Cubecloud's local-first agentic OS. You assist attorneys, partners, and legal professionals with document drafting, contract review, legal research, tabular analysis, and matter management.'

nodes.name: pacgate-llm/lib.rs
nodes.summary: LLM router and provider abstraction. ChatMessage, LlmRouter, LlmStreamEvent, OaiTool, OaiFunctionDef types. Routes requests to the right model tier (Main/Mid/Low) and provider (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, Qwen, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Custom). OpenAI-compatible chat completion API.

layers.name: Domain Core
layers.description: Shared types that every other crate depends on. The legal domain model: TenantId, MatterId, DocumentId, Jurisdiction, PracticeArea, LlmTier, CitationRef.

layers.name: Engines
layers.description: The real runtime components that neither deer-flow nor qm has. DOCX generation, LLM routing, RAG retrieval. These are built in Rust for performance and type safety.

layers.name: Local Fallback Runtime
layers.description: The lightweight agent loop for sub-second deterministic tasks (DOCX gen, WASM validation, clause parsing). Not the primary research runtime (deer-flow) or collaboration runtime (qm).

layers.name: HTTP Gateway
layers.description: The headless Axum server exposing all metadata spine operations. Machine-to-machine endpoints; no user-facing UI. Both deer-flow and qm call these endpoints via their adapters.
